1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and the fabric layer is applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric __are applied as distinct layers that__ extend beyond the radius areas.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __and are applied as separate layers distinct from the laminated composite tape__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape forming the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and the patches are applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and the adhesive layer is distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __and the adhesive layer is applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape and are__ joined together by __the adhesive layer applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, including radius areas between the web and the flanges and between the cap and the web and between the base and the web, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the adhesive layer is applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.
